svg.title: CursorBench 3.2 score versus average cost per task
svg.desc: Scatter plot of CursorBench 3.2 correctness against average USD cost per task. Cost decreases toward the right so the upper-right is higher score at lower cost. Points from the same model family are connected Low, Medium, High, Extra High, then Max. An outer ring marks the Cloud Agent picker default effort preset for that family, not every configurable option in the picker. Hover or tap a point for the model name and effort.
svg.text: Average cost per task (higher cost on the left)
